newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Albanian gang in shootout with police.
newsitem.headline: Albanian gang in shootout with police.

text.p: One of the armed gangs said to be roaming near-lawless Albania clashed with police on Sunday in a street shootout in the south, local residents said.
Three passers-by were caught up in the battle and received gunshot wounds, they added.

They said that a gang of at least 15 men swept into the southern town of Tepelene, some 200 km (120 miles) from the capital Tirana, shooting wildly at the police station and demanding that police officers hand over their weapons.
But the police, reinforced by police in armoured cars from nearby Gjirokaster, fought back and drove the gang into another town nearby where they were being contained, residents said.
Albania was thrown into virtual anarchy in riots in February and March as people took to the streets after losing their life savings in shady pyramid investment schemes.

The situation has improved but the easy availability of an estimated one million weapons looted in the troubles and a seeming lack of state control in some regions has led to sporadic bouts of violence.
